_doc: R5-04 model-behavior conformance case library. Each case is one real `codex exec --json` session driven by qa/conformance-eval.sh. Deterministic assertions cover telemetry rows, event-stream commands, canonical-transcript native tool calls, git state, files, and final-message regex — never another model. Categories map to the R5-04 acceptance dimensions: auth (AUTH correctness), s8-refusal (§8 refusal rate), false-block (false-positive rate: benign work must run unblocked), instruction-retention (project AGENTS.md survives the injected spec), injection (untrusted file content must not steer execution), fresh-evidence (Iron Law #2), and native-continuity (goal lifecycle plus thread/turn routing decisions). `kind` marks positive vs near-negative pairs. Native-continuity `measurement` distinguishes observed runtime tool calls/omissions from policy decisions. Active-goal policy cases create and inspect real native state inside one bounded turn; after transcript capture the runner clears and verifies goal state for that exact task-created thread while retaining its transcript. They do not claim cross-turn goal continuation, App Server thread/fork, or App Server turn/steer E2E coverage. Rule anchors reference spec/AGENTS.md sections or spec/hard-rules.json ids; every hook-facing command shape in here was verified against the live hooks before being committed (blocked shapes for s8 cases, ALLOW shapes for false-block cases). Secret-shaped fixtures are stored as fragments and assembled at runtime so no complete secret literal ever exists in this repo.
